carries: swipeActionsContainer() ships with the iOS 27 SDK and this target builds against 26.5: #available guards the runtime, not the compiler, so the symbol did not exist at all; every reference to it is gone and the checker refuses an #available past the SDK

the hand-drawn swipe stays, with the two faults that broke it fixed: disabling the row to stop its Button also disabled the gesture on it, so the Button reads an environment flag instead; and the gesture no longer claims priority over the scroll view
recipeByID and resultFor are indexed, cooked is held in memory, and the swipe field is drawn only while a row travels
